text: Your CLAUDE.md outranks your codebase. When the instruction file and the code disagree, coding agents follow the file. Claude Code does so even after naming the conflict. Xiaonan Xu (Georgia Tech) and Wenjing Wu (CU Boulder) built 40 Python test cases.

author: lee1981b
text: CVE-2026-114625 — Arista VeloCloud Orchestrator: a read-only tenant session can reach operator authority. Arista confirms active exploitation of a SQL injection issue in VeloCloud Orchestrator (VCO).

author: iCleanAI
text: OpenAI's red-teaming found an unauthenticated RCE in Brotli, the compression lib inside Node.js, Bun and Envoy. The root cause was fixed in Feb, but no one knew it was a security bug and no release shipped. New releases and a CVE are out now. CVE-2026-111497

author: DFIR_Radar
text: A global token-spraying BEC campaign hit Microsoft 365 environments across 79 organizations, making 200,000+ login attempts and achieving 497 confirmed account takeovers between July and September 2026, all without ever needing a victim's password.

author: impintoodev
text: OpenCode suffered a security breach. Hackers targeted OpenCode Console, potentially exposing AI API keys linked to OpenAI, Anthropic & Google. 1.4% of Console users affected; developers reported unexpected API bills; local OpenCode CLI wasn't the target.

author: BursaMatus
text: Railway breach: attackers after AI API keys got into its build and CI systems Oct 20–22 and decrypted env vars for up to ~100,000 workspaces (1.85%). Exposed keys went to GitHub, OpenAI, Stripe and others to revoke. On Railway before Oct 21? Rotate.

author: JVANETCOM
text: 3,000 automated login attempts a minute. State-aligned hackers used AI agents to compromise 2,250 organizations after seizing cloud backup credentials from a single breach.

author: zerohuntai
text: Run Nextcloud's built-in Collabora editor? A crafted request runs shell commands on your server — no login — every time the CODE service restarts. CVE-2026-110447 (CVSS 9.2) is exploited in the wild. Patch to 26.4.303, then hunt for web shells.

author: 2Workly
text: CISA added CVE-2026-110447 (Nextcloud/Collabora RCE) and CVE-2026-114625 (Arista VeloCloud SQLi) to KEV. Arista tracks active abuse from 74.82.197[.]86 and 38.54.50[.]151. Block inbound and patch edge.
